title: Execute Test Command
description: Run a test command deterministically and return a structured PASS/FAIL result with exit code and captured output. Skills that would otherwise teach the agent how to run a test tool should invoke this operation instead.
idempotency: safe to re-run (depends on the test command)
rollback: no writes to roll back (the test command is responsible for its own state)
source_provenance: recovered from legacy skills (tdd-execute, coverage) whose deterministic run/parse step is now reusable code
